prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: clean background plate for a 2D side-view volleyball game.
Primary request: turn the referenced rooftop resort concept into an EMPTY environment background. Remove ALL players, robots, drones, gifts, ball, net, wall buttons, foreground boundary walls and the thick black bottom podium. Reconstruct a beautiful continuous empty rooftop terrace floor.
Scene/backdrop: luxury rooftop garden above a tropical bay at sunset, distant coastal town and mountains, glass safety railing at the back, palms and pink flowering planters at the far edges, small warm pergola at the right edge.
Style/medium: preserve the polished realistic 3D-rendered materials and cinematic sunset color palette of the reference.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:10. Straight side view, symmetric playable empty open central area, horizon halfway down image, back edge of terrace at 75 percent height, unobstructed stone floor bottom quarter. Keep the top center quiet for a small HUD.
Constraints: ONLY architecture, nature, sky and floor. No people, characters, robots, drones, gifts, ball, net, text, UI, logos or watermark. Do not introduce a volleyball court perspective, or a foreground platform/podium. All gameplay objects will be drawn separately by the game.
